scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests-tsx.json && cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run arch && npm run test
scripts.smoke:ui: npm run --silent smoke:ui:frisch && ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="${KLARWERK_SHIP_SMOKE_API_KEY:-}" playwright test --config playwright.smoke.config.ts
scripts.smoke:ui:gate: npm run --silent smoke:ui:frisch && KLARWERK_SMOKE_MODE=gate KLARWERK_SMOKE_OHNE_MODELL=1 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= playwright test --config playwright.smoke.config.ts --project=chromium --project=chromium-zustand --grep-invert @modell
